description: Where a publisher stands right now: their RSS feed URL (the one to submit to Apple Podcasts and Spotify), how many episodes storyflo holds, how many already have finished audio, and how many are still awaiting source audio. Use this for 'what is my feed URL', 'is anything stuck', or as the first call when a publisher asks how things are going.

token.description: Your publisher access token — the same one the dashboard uses. Rotatable at POST /v1/publisher/{slug}/access-token/rotate.
